review_comment: Now that analyzing runs in a separate sequence I've started setting this flag and checking it on the other side as an extra check.

Neat, thanks for factoring away the nested action listeners.

This addresses https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/107953.
The stuff in EsqlSession is now just called directly.
This is nice, but I'd still preserve this comment and place it on top of `runPhase` in line 465; the stuff in there still needs to be close to how the real compute engine runs.
